content.short: Markets.xyz offers onchain perpetual futures on stocks, indices, commodities and crypto.
content.description: Markets.xyz trades perpetual futures on equities, indices and commodities alongside crypto, running continuously rather than to exchange hours, and is built on Hyperliquid by the Kinetiq team. Perpetuals on traditional assets depend entirely on the oracle behaving sensibly when the underlying market is closed, which is the hard part of offering them around the clock.
